raw_sections.experience:
Experience | Regulatory, Risk, Trade & Transaction Platforms
WORK EXPERIENCE
Nasdaq (Adenza India Pvt. Ltd.) | Oct 2023 – Dec 2025 | Specialist – Product Management (Senior BA / Product Owner)
Project: Financial/Statistical Calculations APAC, Trade & Transactions Global • Owned regulatory calculation and trade & transaction reporting platforms across APAC and global markets using AxiomSL v10/v11, supporting SaaS and on-prem deployments.
Acted as Senior Business Analyst and Product Owner proxy, leading functional specifications, user stories, backlog requirement elicitation, prioritization, and release planning. Translated complex regulatory mandates (EMIR, MiFID II, SFTR, regional APAC regulations) into scalable system and product capabilities. Partnered closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Compliance teams to ensure regulatory accuracy, audit readiness, and timely releases. Led end-to-end regulatory lifecycle ownership, including calculation logic validation, post-go-live support, remediation tracking, and regulatory change adoption.



Managed UAT planning, execution, defect triage, and traceability using

JIRA and Confluence across multi-region releases. Served as single point of contact (SPOC) for platform stabilization, stakeholder communication, and production issue resolution.
Authored SOPs, SME documentation, and regulatory playbooks, enabling


long-term operational continuity and knowledge transfer. Coordinated multi-vendor accurate derivatives processing and trade settlement flows. Conducted tool enablement and training sessions for internal and client teams using JIRA, Salesforce, and ServiceNow.

Brought in during high-priority regulatory initiatives and platform stabilization phases, delivering under compressed timelines and immediate ownership expectations.
Ernst & Young LLP | Senior Consultant | Nov 2021 – Sept 2023
Project: Credit Suisse (IBOR Transition, Market Risk, Regulatory Compliance) •
Led Business Analysis workstreams for Market Risk, Regulatory Compliance, and IBOR Transition programs for a Tier-1 global bank (Credit Suisse). Delivered Market Risk, RRP, and ACVA RWA reports aligned with FINMA regulatory requirements, supporting audit and regulatory submissions. Elicited, documented, and validated business and functional requirements for VAR, SVAR, and risk calculation processes. Designed data quality controls, governance frameworks, and reporting workflows in collaboration with Risk, IT, and Front Office stakeholders. Owned UAT strategy, execution, defect management, and business sign-off, ensuring regulatory accuracy and release readiness. Played a key role in the IBOR to ARR transition, supporting APAC and global market implementations.
